events.factual_description: Roulette presents X AMENDMENTS by composer/improviser Carla Kihlstedt and poet Rafael Osés on October 7 and 8, 2026 at 8:00 PM, with doors at 7:00 PM. Roulette describes the work as an improvised sonic structure for an orchestra of voices, electric guitars, and an audience, using the first ten amendments of the United States Constitution as source material. Both nights are advertised at $30 advance, $35 at the door, and $25 student/senior. The October 7 lineup lists Holland Andrews, Gelsey Bell, Carla Kihlstedt, Anaïs Maviel, Kalyn Harewood, and Rafael Osés on voice; the October 8 page lists the same vocalists except Harewood. Both nights list Dither members Taylor Levine, Joshua Lopes, James Moore, and Brendon Randall-Myers on guitar, plus Brandon Ross on guitar. Roulette also states that each performance will be livestreamed free at 8:00 PM and archived. Dither's own events page independently lists Carla Kihlstedt's X Amendments at Roulette for October 7-8, 2026.

en.why_it_matters: The live mechanism is the reason this belongs: Kihlstedt and Osés turn a vocal ensemble, five electric guitars, and the audience into an improvised structure rather than asking a fixed score to carry the evening. The Bill of Rights supplies the text and constraints, but the musical interest is how individual voices and a dense guitar field negotiate freedom, interruption, responsibility, and collective form in real time.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already viable that week, actively make room for one of the two Roulette nights and choose the date that fits the trip. The two-performance run gives enough flexibility that I would not build a dedicated DMV-to-Brooklyn trip around a single night.

es.why_it_matters: La razón para meterlo al RADAR está en el mecanismo en vivo: Kihlstedt y Osés convierten un ensamble de voces, cinco guitarras eléctricas y al público en una estructura improvisada, en vez de dejar que una partitura fija cargue con toda la noche. La Carta de Derechos pone el texto y las restricciones; el interés musical está en cómo las voces individuales y ese campo denso de guitarras negocian libertad, interrupción, responsabilidad y forma colectiva en tiempo real.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya es viable esa semana, sí le haría espacio activamente a una de las dos noches en Roulette y escogería la fecha que mejor embone con el viaje. Al haber dos funciones, no armaría un ida y vuelta dedicado desde el DMV alrededor de una sola noche.
